walkthrough.title: Get started with Spec2Test
walkthrough.description: From an empty machine to Gherkin features you can trace back to your specs.
walkthrough.docker.title: Set up the extension and start Docker
walkthrough.docker.description:
Spec2Test runs in Docker containers that the extension pulls and starts for you. Watch the status in the sidebar footer.
[Open Spec2Test](command:spec2test.focus)
[Start the containers](command:spec2test.startService)
walkthrough.keys.title: Add your API key
walkthrough.keys.description: Sidebar → ⚙ Settings → Environment: paste the key of your LLM provider and press Apply. Keys stay in your OS keychain.
walkthrough.project.title: Create a project and process your inputs
walkthrough.project.description:
New project (+), choose the inputs and features folders, drop your specs and recordings, then press Process.
[Add files to the project](command:spec2test.addFiles)
walkthrough.agents.title: Add the Gherkin-Generator and web-crawler agents
walkthrough.agents.description:
Copies the agents and the MCP settings (input-processor, web-crawler, Playwright) into the open folder, for Copilot, Claude Code or Codex.
[Add the agents to this project](command:spec2test.installAgents)
walkthrough.gherkin.title: Check the traceability
walkthrough.gherkin.description:
Set the features folder, press Gherkin in the sidebar and follow each input to its features and scenarios; fix any warning.
[Open Spec2Test](command:spec2test.focus)
